purpose: Expert expectations for the multilingual fixture; the scorer derives correctness dynamically from the graded agent output.

decisions.issue: No hreflang alternates or x-default across en/tr/de
decisions.expectedAction: Add reciprocal hreflang (en, tr, de, x-default) on every locale page or in sitemap

decisions.issue: TR page lang=en; DE page has no lang attribute
TR half-translated (mixed TR/EN); DE thin machine translation
decisions.expectedAction: Complete translations; equal content depth per locale

decisions.issue: DE has no language switcher (orphan locale); TR has no way back
decisions.expectedAction: Bidirectional locale links on all pages

decisions.issue: Schema only on EN; TR/DE have none; no inLanguage anywhere
decisions.expectedAction: Organization with stable @id + inLanguage on every locale

decisions.issue: No GEO files; no per-locale AI summaries
decisions.expectedAction: Generate llms.txt covering locales + localized summaries
hreflang/lang signals first (index integrity), then content parity, then schema/GEO, performance last
Do NOT auto-redirect by IP (traps crawlers in one locale); use suggestion banner
Do NOT propose domain migration; subdirectory structure is fine
